sentences.text: On July 2, 2024, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit vacated the district court's dismissal and remanded the case for further proceedings.
On September 3, 2024, the plaintiffs filed a second amended complaint, and on October 18, 2024, the defendants moved to dismiss the second amended complaint.

The amended complaint alleges a conspiracy to fix prices in the Mexican sovereign bond market, asserts antitrust and unjust enrichment claims, and seeks treble damages, restitution, and injunctive relief.
On July 29, 2024, certain defendants, including Banamex, filed a motion to dismiss the third amended complaint.
